subject.title: fix: prioritize exhausted Antigravity quota in menu bar and highest usage

question: Should automatic Antigravity selection use reset-focused behavior in the menu bar while highest-usage ranking uses the maximum binding quota, or must both consumers display the same selected lane?
rationale: Both interpretations are plausible, affect existing automatic display behavior, and cannot be resolved from current tests or documentation without product intent.

options.title: Approve context-specific semantics
options.body: Keep reset-focused menu-bar selection and maximum-binding-quota highest-usage ranking, then align cadence parsing and add direct proof for both consumers.

options.title: Require one shared lane
options.body: Make menu-bar display and highest-usage ranking resolve the same quota window so the displayed value always explains why Antigravity won.

options.title: Preserve current behavior
options.body: Do not prioritize exhausted windows automatically and close or substantially narrow this PR if the existing usable-lane preference is intentional.

recommendation.title: Approve context-specific semantics
recommendation.body: Keep reset-focused menu-bar selection and maximum-binding-quota highest-usage ranking, then align cadence parsing and add direct proof for both consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merge history and repository ownership make steipete the best available person to define the user-visible automatic-selection contract.
